Package index

Pipeline: Superior Haplotype Discovery

End-to-end and modular tools for functional variant identification, intragenic haplotype assembly, association testing, gate re-application, and run loading. See haplobreed_analysis() for the single-trait pipeline; the remaining functions are the per-step entry points.

haplobreed_analysis()
Single-trait identification of genes carrying superior haplotypes
hbr_check_inputs()
Pre-flight Validation of Inputs
hbr_generate_input_qc_report()
Generate a unified input-QC report
hbr_read_results()
Read finished HaploBreedR results from disk or memory
hbr_gene_carriers()
Carrier status of the superior haplotype at a gene
hbr_regate()
Re-apply the superior-haplotype rule with different settings

Genomic Selection & Breeding Decisions (HGSI)

Two-kernel spectral REML prediction, cross usefulness, multi-locus pyramiding, haplotype-block calling, and parent-set optimization. hbr_fit_models() and hbr_cross_design() are the two halves of the pipeline; hbr_advanced_decision() runs them end to end.

hbr_advanced_decision()
Breeding decisions from HaploBreedR output
hbr_fit_models()
Fit genomic prediction models and rank parents
hbr_cross_design()
Design crosses from a fitted model
hbr_cross_plan()
Plan a cross between named parents
hbr_cross_usefulness()
Analytical Cross Usefulness
hbr_haplotype_blocks()
Haplotype blocks of target loci
hbr_haplotype_block_table()
Haplotype block table from a set of target loci
hbr_pyramid_probability()
Haplotype Pyramiding Probability
hbr_population_size()
Population Size for Recombinant Recovery
hbr_build_grm()
Streamed Genomic Relationship Matrix
hbr_reml_two_kernel()
Spectral Two-Kernel REML
hbr_trait_conflicts()
Multi-Trait Haplotype Breeding Conflicts

Publication Figures & Visualisation

High-level ggplot2 publication graphics for candidate genes, haplotype networks, gene models, LD structure, cross rankings, and model validation.

hbr_plot_haplotype()
Plot haplotype boxplot with summary table
hbr_plot_gene_structure()
Plot gene structure for one or more genes
hbr_plot_haplotype_network()
Plot a haplotype network for one or more genes
hbr_plot_cross_ranking()
Plot cross ranking by usefulness vs mid-parent index
hbr_plot_cv_forest()
Forest plot of cross-validation comparisons

Variant Annotation & Population Genetics

LD decay estimation, GFF3 gene parsing, genomic-region interval intersection, and GO term over-representation.

hbr_annotate_regions_with_genes()
Annotate LD regions with genes
hbr_read_gff3_genes()
Parse gene features from a GFF3 into a data.table
hbr_go_enrichment()
GO term enrichment across a set of genes

Manuscript Tables & Reporting

Formatted multi-sheet Excel manuscript tables built from a single pipeline run.

hbr_build_manuscript_tables()
Build a manuscript-ready multi-sheet Excel workbook from a pipeline run

Reference Data, Themes & Lookups

Genetic linkage maps, crop genome metadata, colour palettes, and ggplot2 themes shipped with the package.

hbr_rice_genetic_map()
Bundled rice genetic map anchors
hbr_crop_lookup()
Common crops mapped to their Ensembl Plants species and assembly
hbr_palette()
Return `n` colours from a named palette
hbr_palette_names()
Names of the built-in colour palettes
hbr_theme()
Return a named HaploBreedR ggplot2 theme
hbr_theme_names()
Names of the built-in ggplot2 themes

print(<hbr_genotype>)
